projects.name: NexusCloud - Collaborative Task Suite
projects.description: A real-time project management and Kanban workspace designed for distributed teams to collaborate seamlessly with instant notifications, drag-and-drop boards, and sprint analytics.

caseStudy.challenge: Distributed teams experienced inconsistent task synchronization states, high server polling load, and laggy rendering when backlogs exceeded several hundred active items.
caseStudy.approach: Engineered a WebSocket synchronization protocol with optimistic client-side updates, implemented cursor-based pagination for project boards, and optimized MongoDB query indexes with compound keys.
caseStudy.outcome: Achieved sub-100ms real-time state synchronization across all connected clients, decreased server CPU load by 45%, and scaled the system to support 5,000+ simultaneous collaborators with 99.98% uptime.

projects.name: ShopSphere - Headless E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: An ultra-fast headless e-commerce store featuring real-time inventory management, progressive checkout flow, multi-currency support, and comprehensive merchant revenue dashboards.

caseStudy.challenge: The previous storefront had a high checkout abandonment rate (68%) caused by sluggish multi-page redirection and frequent inventory mismatches during peak promotional launches.
caseStudy.approach: Designed a single-page progressive checkout using Stripe Payment Intents, implemented transactional row locking in PostgreSQL to guarantee atomic stock reductions, and leveraged ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration).
caseStudy.outcome: Elevated Lighthouse performance score to 98/100, reduced average checkout completion time by 42%, dropped cart abandonment to 32%, and processed $150k+ in launch transactions without a single stock collision.

projects.name: HealthPulse - Secure Telehealth Consultation Portal
projects.description: A HIPAA-compliant telemedicine platform enabling patients to schedule virtual appointments, attend encrypted HD video calls, and access encrypted electronic medical records.

caseStudy.challenge: Medical providers needed an ultra-secure, tamper-proof video streaming environment that could reliably operate over low-bandwidth mobile networks while safeguarding confidential health data.
caseStudy.approach: Constructed peer-to-peer WebRTC channels with adaptive bitrate streaming and automatic TURN relay fallbacks, implemented AES-256 encrypted storage for consultation notes, and built strict role-based access control.
caseStudy.outcome: Successfully hosted over 15,000 secure video consultations with zero security breaches, maintained video clarity on 3G connections, and received a 4.9/5 patient satisfaction score across clinic partners.

projects.name: DevMetrics - Developer Insights & Repository Analytics
projects.description: An interactive analytics dashboard that ingests Git repository metadata to visualize commit velocity, code churn, test coverage, and team productivity trends in real-time.

caseStudy.challenge: Engineering leaders lacked an intuitive, unified dashboard to detect code bottlenecks, track PR review cycles, and celebrate sprint milestones across dozens of distributed repositories.
caseStudy.approach: Connected to GitHub and GitLab GraphQL APIs using asynchronous worker queues, computed rolling code velocity metrics in Redis caches, and rendered high-fps reactive charts.
caseStudy.outcome: Shortened average PR turnaround times by 28%, saved engineering managers 4+ hours per sprint in reporting, and earned adoption across 20+ engineering organizations.
